text: Xiaomi on Aug 2 increased official retail prices on select models via its Xiaomi Mall. Xiaomi 17 series prices were raised by 300–500 yuan per unit; Redmi’s lineup, including performance-focused Turbo 5 and K90 series variants, broadly rose about 300 yuan.
text_zh: 小米于8月2日通过小米商城上调了部分机型的官方零售价格。小米17系列每台售价上调300至500元；红米产品线，包括主打性能的Turbo 5和K90系列各版本，普遍上调约300元。
